title: InfiniContext settings
description: Defaults live in settings.json (committed); user overrides live in settings.user.json (gitignored). Environment variables prefixed INFINICONTEXT__ overlay both.

directory.description: Directory for per-run log files. Relative paths resolve from the host's working directory.

flushIntervalMs.description: Serilog file sink flush-to-disk interval, in milliseconds.

maxFieldBytes.description: Truncate any log scalar string longer than this, in UTF-8 bytes.

rxTruncationBytes.description: Truncate the rx: log line for each received event to this many bytes.

eventChannelCapacity.description: Bounded channel size for per-session event queue. Drop-oldest under back-pressure.

stderrRingCapacity.description: Ring buffer size for stderr drained from the claude child.

stdoutDrainTimeoutSeconds.description: Grace period to wait for stdout/stderr tasks during session disposal.

exitDrainWaitSeconds.description: REPL grace period after session signals exit, before printing the exit summary.

interruptTimeoutSeconds.description: Deadline for the interrupt operation triggered by Ctrl+C.

model.description: Default --model for spawned claude processes. null = let claude pick its default.

includePartialMessages.description: Pass --include-partial-messages to receive SSE-shaped stream_event records.

extraArgs.description: Extra args appended verbatim to the claude invocation.

timeoutSeconds.description: Wait for user y/n on approval prompt before auto-deny. Design doc §4.6 default: 60.

mode.description: Default decision policy for tool-permission requests. 'Ask' prompts the user (default). 'Deny' auto-denies everything. 'Auto' consults the light model. 'Allow' is intentionally NOT a persisted default — switch via CLI (--approval-mode allow) or REPL (/approval allow) for one session at a time.

onLowConfidence.description: Behavior when the light model's allow verdict has low confidence. 'Deny' fails closed; 'FallbackToAsk' surfaces the prompt to the user.

timeoutSeconds.description: Wall-clock deadline for the light-model API call. On timeout, behaves as low-confidence.

effort.description: Effort tier for the safety verdict. 'Low' (default): non-thinking, ~2.3 s p50, $0.0007/call. 'High': thinking enabled, ~9 s p50, ~$0.0074/call. Same axis on both SDK and CLI back ends.

mode.description: Meaningful ONLY for non-API subscriptions (no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) — ignored when the SDK back end is in use. Controls the CLI back-end lifecycle for auto-mode safety review specifically. 'SingleShot' (default, recommended): fresh process per call — real isolation between unrelated tool calls. 'LongLived': single child reused across calls with cosmetic /clear isolation only — usually wrong for safety review. Independent of models.light.cli.mode (which controls the default for general consumers).

sidecarConnectTimeoutSeconds.description: Deadline for the approval sidecar to connect back to the host's named pipe.

approvalChannelDisposeTimeoutSeconds.description: Grace period for the approval-channel server task to exit on disposal.

minClaudeVersion.description: Hard floor: claude versions below this are refused. Design doc §7.3.

testedAgainstVersion.description: Version Stage 0 fixtures were recorded against. Mismatch → soft warning.

id.description: Identifier of the host's main model. Currently informational; the active main-model channel is the spawned claude child. Reserved for future host-side direct calls.
Anthropic model id used by ILightModelService. Default: claude-haiku-4-5.

maxTokens.description: Cap on output tokens per light-model call (SDK back end).

timeoutSeconds.description: Wall-clock deadline for one light-model call (both back ends).

cli.description: Knobs for the CLI back end (OAuth-only fallback). See docs/research/claude-cli-light-model.md §6.

mode.description: Meaningful ONLY for non-API subscriptions (no ANTHROPIC_API_KEY) — ignored when the SDK back end is in use. Default lifecycle for general (non-auto-mode) CLI light-model consumers — title generation, classification, summarization. 'LongLived' (default, highly recommended): one process across many calls, amortized startup, /clear between turns for cosmetic isolation. 'SingleShot': fresh process per call (~2.3 s p50, real isolation) — pays startup cost every call; only use if leakage between bulk calls would actually matter. Auto-mode safety review reads its own approval.auto.mode, not this setting.

maxOutputTokens.description: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS for non-thinking calls. 128 matches the safety-verdict size.

thinkingMaxOutputTokens.description: CLAUDE_CODE_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS for thinking calls. 1024 is a placeholder; the right ceiling is an open benchmark sub-question.

claudeExecutable.description: Override the resolved claude executable. Mainly for tests.

managedCwd.description: Working directory the child runs in. null = %USERPROFILE%/.infinicontext/light-cwd/.

tasks.description: Stage 2A task registry + lock subsystem. Threshold and model-context-window keys land alongside Phase 8.

dbPath.description: Override for the SQLite registry path. null resolves to %USERPROFILE%/.infinicontext/infinicontext.db.

lockTtlSeconds.description: How long a granted task-artifact lock stays valid before auto-expiry. Default 30.

lockMaxWaitSeconds.description: How long a competing session waits for a contended lock before reporting a timeout. Default 60.

softThresholdPct.description: Context window % at which the host injects a polite 'flush at next stopping point' nudge. Default 60.

hardThresholdPct.description: Context window % at which the host injects a firm 'flush now, no new work' nudge. Must be strictly greater than softThresholdPct. Default 85.

modelContextWindows.description: Fallback context-window map keyed by model id, used when claude's own modelUsage.contextWindow is absent.

cosmetics.description: Customisable user-facing strings. None of these change behavior.
